Get detailed audio analysis for a specific track. Parameters: ---------- track_id : str (Spotify track ID)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackAnalysis
Basic track info (name, artists, genre)
Track duration in milliseconds
Audio features (tempo, key, mode, energy etc.)
Notes: ----- If track hasn't been analyzed, initiates analysis and returns processing status.

Get real-time status updates for track analysis via Server-Sent Events (SSE). Parameters: ---------- track_id : str (Spotify track ID)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- EventSourceResponse
Status updates as SSE events
Event types: status, complete, error
Notes: ----- Maintains an active connection until analysis is complete or fails.
